title: 网孔电流法的交流版：两个网孔
statement: 和 World 2 的 `methods-02-mesh-two-meshes` 同一个结构，只是 R_3 换成了电感 L、R_4 换成了电容 C，两个电压源换成了同频率的正弦源。
ω = 1000 rad/s，V̇_s1 = 10∠0° V，V̇_s2 = 6∠0° V（有效值相量），R_1 = 2 Ω，L = 2 mH，R_2 = 4 Ω，C = 250 µF。两个网孔电流 İ_m1、İ_m2 都取**顺时针**方向。
用**网孔电流法**求 İ_m1、İ_m2、中间支路向下的电流 İ_3，以及 V_s2 吸收的平均功率。

questions.ask: 网孔电流 |İ_m1| = ?（等于图中 R_1 的电流 İ_1）
questions.explain: 解出 İ_m1 = 1∠0° A：它正好和两个电源同相。

questions.ask: 网孔电流 |İ_m2| = ?（等于图中 C 的电流 İ_4）
V_s2 吸收的平均功率 P = ?
questions.explain: P = Re(V̇_s2·İ_3*) = Re(6 × j1) = 0。V_s2 的电流比电压落后 90°，平均下来既不吸收也不发出功率。直流题里 V_s2 吸收 8 W；交流里只有和电压同相的那部分电流才产生平均功率。

hints: 规则和直流一样：自阻抗 × 本网孔电流 − 互阻抗 × 相邻网孔电流 = 本网孔中电压源的电压升之和。
先算阻抗：Z_L = jωL，Z_C = −j/(ωC)。两个网孔共用中间支路，互阻抗就是 Z_L；V̇_s2 在两个网孔里符号相反。
网孔 1 的方程两边除以 2 后是 (1 + j)İ_m1 − jİ_m2 = 2；用它把 İ_m2 写成 İ_m1 的式子，再代入网孔 2。
solution: **2. 网孔 1：** (R_1 + Z_L)İ_m1 − Z_L·İ_m2 = V̇_s1 − V̇_s2 → (2 + j2)İ_m1 − j2İ_m2 = 4。顺时针绕网孔 1，经过 V_s2 是从“+”到“−”，是电压降，所以减去。

en.title: Mesh analysis, AC edition: two meshes
statement: Same structure as World 2's `methods-02-mesh-two-meshes`; only R_3 has become an inductor L, R_4 a capacitor C, and the two voltage sources are sinusoids of the same frequency.
ω = 1000 rad/s, V̇_s1 = 10∠0° V, V̇_s2 = 6∠0° V (rms phasors), R_1 = 2 Ω, L = 2 mH, R_2 = 4 Ω, C = 250 µF. Both mesh currents İ_m1 and İ_m2 are **clockwise**.
Use **mesh analysis** to find İ_m1, İ_m2, the downward current İ_3 in the middle branch, and the average power absorbed by V_s2.

questions.ask: Mesh current |İ_m1| = ? (equal to the current İ_1 in R_1 on the drawing)
questions.explain: The solution is İ_m1 = 1∠0° A: exactly in phase with both sources.

questions.ask: Mesh current |İ_m2| = ? (equal to the current İ_4 in C on the drawing)
Average power absorbed by V_s2, P = ?
questions.explain: P = Re(V̇_s2·İ_3*) = Re(6 × j1) = 0. The current in V_s2 lags its voltage by 90°, so on average it neither absorbs nor delivers power. In the DC problem V_s2 absorbed 8 W; in AC only the part of the current in phase with the voltage gives average power.

hints: Same rule as in DC: self-impedance × own mesh current − mutual impedance × neighbouring mesh current = sum of the source voltage rises in the mesh.
First compute the impedances: Z_L = jωL, Z_C = −j/(ωC). The two meshes share the middle branch, so the mutual impedance is Z_L; V̇_s2 enters the two meshes with opposite signs.
Divided by 2, the mesh-1 equation is (1 + j)İ_m1 − jİ_m2 = 2; use it to write İ_m2 in terms of İ_m1, then substitute into mesh 2.
solution: **2. Mesh 1:** (R_1 + Z_L)İ_m1 − Z_L·İ_m2 = V̇_s1 − V̇_s2 → (2 + j2)İ_m1 − j2İ_m2 = 4. Going clockwise round mesh 1 you pass V_s2 from + to −, a drop, so it is subtracted.
**5. Middle branch:** İ_3 = İ_m1 − İ_m2 = **−j1 A = 1∠−90° A**.
**Check (power balance).** V_s1 delivers Re(10 × 1) = 10 W; R_1 absorbs 1² × 2 = 2 W, R_2 absorbs (√2)² × 4 = 8 W; L, C and V_s2 take 0 W. 2 + 8 = 10 W ✓.
